szoveg_eredeti:
Ali here, co-founder of Nuvio. We’re back with Nuvio 5.0!

We built Nuvio so founders could spend less time updating their finances. With v5, you can hand more of that work to your AI assistant.

Our earlier launch earned #1 Product of the Week in Fintech. Thank you to everyone who supported us then. We’re excited to show you what’s changed.

We started Nuvio because managing business finances meant too many spreadsheets, disconnected tools and manual steps. We wanted software that spoke our language as founders, without making us learn accounting first.

Now, you can ask Nuvio to do the work, not just explain the numbers.

Create an invoice, add an expense, update a customer or reconcile a payment. The assistant inside Nuvio works with your actual records and shows you what it’s about to save before making the change. When a payment needs a bank transaction, it asks you to choose it.

Less clicking through forms. Less entering the same information yourself.

You can also use the AI agent you already work with.

Nuvio MCP connects ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or Grok Bot to your Nuvio account. Ask your agent to record an expense or match a bank transaction to an invoice, and the result lands directly in Nuvio.

You choose which company it works in, and it can only perform actions your role allows.

You shouldn’t have to leave your workflow just to keep your finances updated.

The everyday app is still at the centre.

Automated invoice and expense scanning, categorisation, reconciliation and cash flow visibility are still there. This release also makes bank reconnects easier and keeps every line intact when scanning long invoices.

And we’re bringing accounting support into the same setup.

Alongside the app, we’re adding packages for monthly bookkeeping, applicable sales tax / GST / HST filing, and corporate income tax filing and advisory. You can keep your own accountant or get matched with someone who already knows Nuvio.

Software for the daily work. Professional support for the accounting you want to hand over.

What’s the first financial task you’d want your AI agent to handle?

Weboldal: https://www.nuvio.io
